channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Check Destination Gas Before You Bridge Crypto
item.description: A bridge can move tokens without funding the destination network’s fees; check the delivery mode, gas token and wallet balance before you start each time.

item.title: Keep SOL ready for your first cross-chain swap
item.description: Keep SOL in the destination wallet for Solana fees, check the route’s output token and address, and leave room for account setup before signing a first cross-chain swap.

item.title: Ledger says implant sent CryptoBilis wallet phrases over LTE
item.description: Ledger says a hidden implant in CryptoBilis-sold wallets read 24-word recovery phrases from device screens and sent them over LTE, exposing funds to theft.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Swap Routes Carry Different Risks
item.description: Cross-chain swap routes differ because each path uses different pools, chains and settlement steps, changing price impact, fees, delays and failure exposure.

item.title: Mayan bridge fees vary by route for stablecoin transfers
item.description: Mayan lists a 0.10% fee for Wormhole Swap, but stablecoin transfer costs also include network and execution fees that vary by route.

item.title: How thor swap handles a BTC-to-ETH trade in one flow
item.description: A BTC-to-ETH swap coordinates a Bitcoin sale with Ethereum delivery, combining steps that otherwise require separate transfers in one service flow.

item.title: South Korea to block 27 crypto sites, including KuCoin
item.description: South Korea approved access restrictions on 27 unregistered crypto sites, including KuCoin and BitMart, extending controls from mobile apps to websites.

item.title: XRPL defends emergency XRP overflow patch after decentralization criticism
item.description: XRPL developers defended the Sept. 25 patch after a bug could mint spendable XRP; the fix bypassed the usual validator vote to avoid weeks of public exposure.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to Add USDC on Sui for Galaxy Users
item.description: Samsung says USDC transfers are coming to eligible U.S. Galaxy users in late October, with Sui among the networks supporting wallet access for cross-border payments.

item.title: XRPL fixed decade-old flaw that could mint 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL says it fixed an integer-overflow flaw in version 3.4.1 on Sept. 25; a crafted payment could have created spendable XRP, with no public exploitation found.

item.title: ESMA Sets Three-Month Deadline for Non-MiCA Stablecoins
item.description: ESMA told MiCA-authorised crypto firms to stop serving non-compliant stablecoins and gave national regulators three months to clear existing exposures.

item.title: ESMA opens evidence call on tokenised collateral for EU clearing
item.description: ESMA opened a call for evidence on tokenised collateral for EU clearing houses, seeking views on safeguards and market mechanics before a January 2027 deadline.

item.title: Thailand SEC sets Oct. 16 start for bitcoin, ether ETF rules
item.description: Thailand’s SEC issued 11 crypto ETF notifications allowing funds focused on bitcoin or ether, opening a local-market route when rules take effect Oct. 16.

item.title: ESMA sets Jan. 8 deadline for non-MiCA stablecoins
item.description: ESMA told EU supervisors to stop authorized crypto firms servicing non-MiCA stablecoins, with existing customer exposures to be resolved within three months.

item.title: Solana sets final 200ms slot-time cut for next epoch
item.description: Solana plans to cut target slot times to 200 milliseconds at its next mainnet epoch, doubling block opportunities while leaving capacity near current levels.

item.title: ESMA sets Jan. 8 deadline for non-MiCA stablecoins
item.description: ESMA says EU-authorized crypto firms should stop servicing non-MiCA stablecoins, with national regulators to resolve existing exposures by Jan. 8, 2027.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates with $6 million
item.description: Fairshake will support 32 House incumbents, with six receiving $1 million each, as the CLARITY Act remains stalled in the Senate before November’s midterms.

item.title: Wells Fargo and Kraken Parent Payward Discuss Crypto Liquidity
item.description: Wells Fargo is discussing a deal for Kraken parent Payward to supply crypto trading liquidity, a potential link between a major U.S. bank and an exchange operator.

item.title: Coinbase completes Deribit integration, plans Pro return by year-end
item.description: Coinbase says Deribit integration has formed Coinbase Global Exchange, while Coinbase Pro is set to return by year-end with spot, derivatives and equities trading.

item.title: When to Choose cowswap for a Token Swap
item.description: Choose cowswap when a swap needs price competition across DEXs and MEV protection; use a direct pool when its quoted output already suits the trade.
